tuning.appendCachedContext: Repository rules: localized MDX is stored in a locale subdirectory beside the English post. Parent-relative image paths such as ../image.webp are correct and required; do not restore English-relative paths. Localized frontmatter inherits date, draft, unlisted, hidden, publish, and popularity from English: their omission is correct. Preserve modified and other controlled metadata. sourceHash is legitimate translation provenance, not an unauthorized addition. Translate reader-facing titles/headings; same-page fragments should match localized headings. Base medium/high findings on actual meaning, executable code, rendered structure, or language defects, not differences explicitly allowed above.
